products.name: Pure Gau Balm

products.name: Gau Face Cream
products.description: Luxurious daily moisturizer infused with gau extract and aloe vera. Helps reduce blemishes, evens skin tone, and provides all-day hydration without clogging pores.

products.name: Gau Herbal Soap
products.description: Handmade cold-process soap with pure gau and neem. Gentle on sensitive skin, naturally antibacterial, and leaves a refreshing herbal scent. Free from synthetic fragrances and parabens.

products.name: Gau Capsules (60ct)
products.description: Concentrated gau extract in easy-to-swallow vegetarian capsules. Supports immune health, reduces inflammation, and promotes overall wellness. Lab-tested for purity and potency.

products.name: BioBoost Root Enhancer
products.description: Contains Rhizobium and Azotobacter strains that fix atmospheric nitrogen and improve root architecture. Increases nutrient uptake by up to 40% and reduces fertilizer dependency.

products.name: PhosphoSol Microbial Mix
products.description: Phosphate-solubilizing bacteria that convert insoluble phosphorus into plant-available forms. Boosts flowering, fruiting, and seed production. Suitable for all soil types and crops.

products.name: VermiRich Compost Plus
products.description: Premium vermicompost enriched with beneficial microorganisms. Improves soil structure, water retention, and microbial activity. Ideal for organic farming and home gardening.

products.name: Mycorrhizal Inoculant
products.description: Contains endomycorrhizal fungi that form symbiotic relationships with plant roots, extending the root network for better nutrient and water absorption. Reduces transplant shock significantly.

products.name: BioFert All-Purpose Blend
products.description: A balanced consortium of nitrogen-fixing, phosphate-solubilizing, and potassium-mobilizing bacteria. One application covers all major nutrient needs for vegetables, fruits, and grains.

products.name: Organic Tulsi (Holy Basil)
products.description: Farm-fresh Rama and Krishna tulsi varieties, shade-dried to preserve essential oils. Known as the Queen of Herbs for its adaptogenic and immune-boosting properties.

products.name: Ashwagandha Root Powder
products.description: Premium KSM-66 ashwagandha root powder, organically grown and lab-verified for withanolide content. Supports stress relief, better sleep, and enhanced physical performance.

products.name: Turmeric Root Powder
products.description: High-curcumin turmeric powder from Lakadong variety, containing 7-12% curcumin. Anti-inflammatory powerhouse for cooking, golden milk, and traditional remedies.

products.name: Dried Lemongrass
products.description: Aromatic lemongrass stalks, sun-dried and cut for easy brewing. Makes a refreshing tea that aids digestion, relieves anxiety, and naturally repels insects.

products.name: Moringa Leaf Powder
products.description: Nutrient-dense moringa oleifera leaves, shade-dried and finely ground. Contains 92 nutrients, 46 antioxidants, and all essential amino acids. A true superfood for smoothies and meals.

testimonials.name: Priya Sharma
testimonials.text: The BioBoost Root Enhancer has completely transformed my tomato yield. My plants are healthier, the soil feels alive, and I have reduced my chemical fertilizer usage by 60%. Truly a game-changer for sustainable farming.

testimonials.name: Dr. Rajesh Patel
testimonials.text: I recommend the Gau Healing Oil and Ashwagandha Root Powder to my patients regularly. The quality and potency are outstanding — you can tell these are genuinely organic and carefully processed.

testimonials.name: Anita Desai
testimonials.text: The VermiRich Compost Plus brought my struggling rose garden back to life. Within weeks, the soil texture improved dramatically and the plants started blooming like never before. I am a customer for life!
